text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Trainer <username>!
Lookin' full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, we'll be making the initial construction plan soon!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"The outcome of the evaluation meeting held every six months
will decide the future of this island—"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
In other words,
the construction plan for that is super-duper important!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"Are you ready to rack your brains for the evaluation meeting
six months from now and put together the best possible
construction plan... Well, are ya?"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: “—Dahahaha! Just kidding, don't look so stiff!”

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Well, "experience is the best teacher"! Either way, let's give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I shall also participate when drafting the construction plans!
Let us rack our brains together!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, and another thing! I'm planning to drop by
your daily academy training
and the island training sessions as well!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: To build better facilities, we'll gain insights together through training and tackle the construction plan!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Let us forge the future of Tracen Island!
Wahahaha!
